transcript.text: Hey! I'm Riley, I want to read every day

Hey Riley, I'm ZOH! I'll help you get better at one thing with a small step each day. Text "stop" anytime, and tell me whenever you want me to coach differently, like "chill out" or "push me harder". Reading every day? Let's go! Is there a book you're in the middle of, or one you've been meaning to start?
mostly fantasy, I read on my phone on the train
Fantasy on the train, nice combo. Which ride is your reading ride, and what time does it usually start?
on my commute around 8am, 20 min
20 minutes on the 8am train is a solid daily slot, and it's already in your routine. Which fantasy book are you reading right now, or starting?
nah I don't track it
No tracking is fine, Riley. We'll keep it simple. Where do you want daily reading to get you, like finishing a certain book, a number of books, or just making it a habit? "Not sure yet" works too.
less emojis pls

Got it, fewer emojis. Fantasy on your phone during the 8am train is a ready-made reading slot, so here's the plan:

• Setup for tonight: pick the fantasy book and have it open on your phone
• Day 1 is tomorrow at 8 am: 20 minutes of reading on the train
• After you read, send a 30-second voice recap in your own words
• Every day, same slot
• The recap helps the story stick. If you can't talk, a screenshot of the page you stopped on works too.

I'll text you at 7:50 am to get you going. Each day's reading shapes the next step, and we'll adjust as we learn what works for you. What do you think?
honestly is 20 min even worth it?

Fair question, Riley. At a normal reading pace, 20 minutes a day adds up to roughly a dozen or more fantasy novels a year, even the chunky ones. The bigger win is that a daily habit on a train you already ride is much easier to keep than a big reading goal. What's making you doubt it: does it feel too short, or like it won't add up?
lol ok
Ha, fair enough, Riley. So are you in for 20 minutes on the 8am train every day, starting tomorrow? I need a clear yes from you before I lock it.
